splunk-windows-report:1.title: Step 1: Find the controls
splunk-windows-report:1.where: SPLUNK01 → browser → Splunk Web → Search & Reporting; not a terminal
splunk-windows-report:1.why: A useful handoff lets another analyst repeat your search and understand what is known. Screenshots supplement searchable records; preserve original evidence with access controls and the organization’s retention procedure.
splunk-windows-report:1.needs: Use SPL in Search & Reporting, not SPL2 or PowerShell. The supplied event dates are fixed; use All time except when the task deliberately tests a different time range.
